remarks: Ideally situated in Stamford's Glenbrook neighborhood, this beautifully updated first-floor end unit offers the perfect combination of comfort and convenience. A commuter's dream, it's just minutes from the train station with easy access to I-95.  This bright and inviting home features two spacious bedrooms and a full bath-all on one level for easy living. Sunlight fills the living room, dining area, and bedrooms, all enhanced by hardwood floors that add warmth and character throughout. The updated kitchen is equipped with all the essential appliances, making meal preparation both simple and efficient. Additional conveniences include heat and hot water covered in the common charges. Just moments from Stamford's vibrant downtown, this home places you close to shopping, dining, and all the city has to offer.
